title: The Toaster
summary: Paddy discovers Billy keeps his toaster in a cupboard and cannot comprehend this Protestant peculiarity, leading to an intervention.

scenes.visual: Wide shot of Billy's immaculate kitchen. Billy opens a cupboard door revealing a gleaming toaster sitting inside. Paddy stands in background, jaw dropping in slow motion as camera slowly zooms in on the cupboard.
scenes.narration: A discovery that would rock foundations.

scenes.visual: Extreme close-up on Paddy's face showing complete bewilderment. His eyes blink rapidly, mouth agape, frozen in disbelief.
Medium shot of Billy standing defensively next to the open cupboard, arms crossed. His face shows stubborn determination mixed with slight embarrassment.
Medium two-shot of Paddy and Billy facing each other across the fence. Paddy gesticulates wildly while Billy holds his tea mug defensively.
Close-up on Billy's face showing mounting irritation. He takes a deliberate sip of tea, eyes never leaving Paddy.
Wide shot of Paddy's kitchen showing his toaster prominently displayed on the counter. Paddy points at it dramatically while Deirdre sits at table with her head in her hands.
scenes.narration: Emergency consultations were called for immediately.

scenes.visual: Medium shot of Deirdre looking directly at camera with extreme exasperation. She slowly removes her hands from her face and sighs deeply.
Extreme close-up of both men's faces in profile, glaring at each other across the fence with stubborn determination.
Medium two-shot showing both men simultaneously lifting their tea mugs in a reluctant toast. Their expressions remain stern but show hints of resigned acceptance.
Wide shot pulling back to show both men at the fence drinking tea in comfortable silence. Camera slowly drifts back as the sun sets behind the terraced houses.
scenes.narration: Some mysteries would remain unsolved forever.
